messages.subject: sandwich estimators
parts:
If I run the following:

ezANOVA(cbind(part, diag.data), wid=.(part), between=.(group), dv=.
(descript), detailed=TRUE, white.adjust='hc3')

I get:

Error in !white.adjust : invalid argument type

However,

ezANOVA(cbind(part, diag.data), wid=.(part), between=.(group), dv=.
(descript), detailed=TRUE, white.adjust=TRUE)

will work (presumably giving the default 'hc3' robust standard errors.
I just wanted to see whether any of the estimator matched what I get
from multcomp and sandwich via glht().

(The documentation implies the argument is passed, but is seems only
to pass TRUE or FALSE, Anova() in car accepts: white.adjust=c(FALSE,
TRUE, "hc3", "hc0", "hc1", "hc2", "hc4" ).

Thom
